key_reasoning.reason: Touches six related production components in one subsystem — CommonStateFields (new showTask/showOutputSchema props), CustomTab (live custom_node_id state gating Task visibility), SubWorkflowTab, ToolTab (both wired to hide Task/Output Schema), CustomNodeForm (onCustomNodeIdChange callback) and CustomNodeSelector (new CUSTOM_NODE_TYPES_USING_TASK set). All single UI layer, no new subsystems or cross-cutting abstractions.

13 files changed per diffstat (6 production files, 7 test files), all within src/pages/workflows/editor/configPanels and its components/ subdirectory — maps to the 11-15 file XL band per the file-count rule, even though the directory footprint is narrow.
